issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core OperationOutcome change request for STU3 asking to remove wording suggesting an OperationOutcome might be sent as part of a request message; the issue rationale said such cases should use DetectedIssue or a bare extension instead.
initial_application: Commit d35f11882260b501390ebb9453e15ce5eb15f1b0, labelled GF#18514, removed the exact sentence "If sent with extensions overriding particular issues, might even appear as part of a request message" from source/operationoutcome/operationoutcome-spreadsheet.xml. The later 2021 source rework preserved the remaining response-message wording in structuredefinition-OperationOutcome.xml.
additional_context: OperationOutcome is active in source/fhir.ini and listed as a special resource. Current operationoutcome-introduction.xml lists OperationOutcome as part of a message response and states that clinical or workflow issues associated with a proposed or ongoing action are handled with DetectedIssue or other resources. Current structuredefinition-OperationOutcome.xml says OperationOutcome can be part of the response message returned from a request message; this does not reintroduce the removed request-message usage.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the current build source no longer suggests placing OperationOutcome in a request message.
